title: SWF compile: registrationPoint on SymbolInstance not applied to PlaceObject2 matrix
description: SymbolInstance.registrationPoint?: {x, y} exists in the model but compile.ts never reads it. The registration point offset should shift the PlaceObject2 translation matrix so that rotation/scale happen around the symbol's registration point rather than (0,0). Fix: when registrationPoint is present, add regX/regY offsets to the PlaceObject2 tx/ty values (or compose as a translate-rotate-translate matrix).
